metadata.title: Infinigen Cuboid API Reference
metadata.description: Facade-focused DSL summary for bbox-driven primitive programs. Keep the prompt surface on cuboid composition helpers instead of the broader curve/modifier stack.

replay_context: Facade primitives in this family are bbox-first and usually assemble geometry by placing axis-aligned boxes.
Use direct cuboid composition helpers before considering broader Infinigen curve or modifier APIs.
script_notes: Prefer `new_bbox(...)` for walls, windows, lintels, sills, jambs, and other panel-like elements.
Use `join_objects(...)` only when the primitive script needs one merged object after constructing multiple bbox pieces.

functions.name: new_bbox
functions.signature: new_bbox(xmin: float, xmax: float, ymin: float, ymax: float, zmin: float, zmax: float)
functions.purpose: Create one axis-aligned cuboid from explicit min/max bounds. This is the primary facade-building primitive.
functions.returns: bpy.types.Object (MESH) for the cuboid, linked to the active scene.
side_effects: Applies the transform so the mesh matches the requested bbox
functions.notes: Use this directly for facade panels and openings. Do not replace it with unrelated curve helpers.

functions.name: join_objects
functions.purpose: Merge several bbox-built pieces into one object when the primitive script needs a combined facade element.

inputs.name: objs
inputs.description: Objects to merge into the active object.

side_effects: Merges object data into one output object
functions.notes: Use only after constructing the individual cuboids that belong together.
